body.name: Composed encoded interval \(I_n^{\mathrm{fp}}\)
body.construction: Apply \(\mathsf{Enc}_{p_n,L_n}\) to the real Gaussian observations. Set \(I_n^{\mathrm{fp}}=I_n^{\mathrm{dyad}}\) when \(\kappa_n=0\), where \(I_n^{\mathrm{dyad}}\) is returned by \(H_n^{\mathrm{cert}}\) from the exact dyadic arrays and their coordinate-error boxes; set \(I_n^{\mathrm{fp}}=[-M_0,M_0]\) when \(\kappa_n=1\).
